messages:
matt: Heads-up: planning Karpenter migration for GPU clusters this weekend. want a quick safety checklist before cutover? /cc @sasha @anya

anya: +1. main worries: AZ imbalance with instance selectors, ENI limits on p4d-ish shapes, and eviction storms during scale-down.

sasha: also watch taints/labels. our current node-pools rely on node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true label and tolerations. Karpenter uses nodeTemplate + labels - testing mapping now.

leo: can we run smoke e2e on staging: create pods that request GPU + persistent PVCs and crash-loop triggers?

matt: yes. propose steps: (1) dry-run provisioner in staging; (2) run soak with burst load; (3) enable consolidation; (4) run safety kills.

anya: add network check: ENI/headroom. in us-west-2 some shapes only allow 8 ENIs => packing matters. we should set topologySpreadConstraints and maxPodsPerNode.

infra-bot: deployment-checklist: provisioner-crd dry-run succeeded on staging. metrics: node-launch-latency=22s, kubelet-ready=18s.

sasha: sample provisioner snippet I'm testing: ```yaml
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1alpha5
kind: Provisioner
metadata:
  name: gpu-mig
spec:
  requirements:
    - key: kubernetes.io/arch
      operator: In
      values: [amd64]
    - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
      operator: In
      values: [spot, on-demand]
  provider:
    instanceProfile: redwood-infer
    instanceSelector:
      instanceTypes: [g5.2xlarge, g5.4xlarge]
  consolidation:
    enabled: true
  ttlSecondsAfterEmpty: 30
  schedule: []
```

leo: watch the spot fallbacks. set nodeAffinity or fallback-only annotation? we should prefer spot but guarantee on-demand fallback for critical ops.

anya: add safety: set taints: dedicated=ml:NoSchedule for training jobs. set scaleDownUtilizationThreshold to 0.15.

matt: kubectl commands to run in staging: ```bash
kubectl apply -f provisioner-gpu.yaml
kubectl run gpu-smoke --image=nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:11.7 --requests='nvidia.com/gpu=1' --restart=Never -- bash -c "nvidia-smi || true"
```

sasha: noted. one more: metric alerts for scale-up loops. if node-launch-latency > 60s for 5m, rollback Karpenter.

leo: also confirm kube-proxy and CNI versions; we've seen IP exhaustion when CNI mismatch + rapid node churn.

matt: ok plan: cutover window Sat 02:00 UTC. assign owners: staging run = sasha, ENI headroom checks = anya, alerting = leo. I'll own rollback playbook.

anya: :thumbsup: adding runbook entries to infra-runbooks/karpenter-migration.md

infra-bot: note: saved snapshot of nodegroup autoscaler config at 1768190000 (s3://redwood-backups/infra/1768190000-autoscaler.json)

matt: perfect. will post final go/no-go 1h before.
